features.name: Preferences / Settings
features.case: Open Settings. Assert the nine config sections render with schema-driven fields and a form change writes a sparse PUT /api/config patch. Desktop also exposes provider/model/reasoning in its Model view; native exposes those in the composer pills.

features.name: Composer model picker
features.case: Open the composer model pill. Assert a catalog of providers/models. Pick a model and assert config.set {key:'model', value:'<model> --provider <provider>'}.

features.name: Reasoning effort control
features.case: Click the reasoning pill. Assert effort choices. Pick a level and assert config.set {key:'reasoning', value:<level>}.

features.name: Command palette
features.case: Press the command-palette shortcut. Assert a filtered action list and keyboard navigation.

features.name: Clarify requests
features.case: Run a turn that calls clarify. Assert the question/choices render and the chosen answer reaches the model.

features.name: Approval requests
features.case: Run an approval-gated action. Assert the approval card renders and the choice reaches the model.

features.name: Session search
features.case: Type in the sidebar search; assert the session rows filter.

features.name: Light/dark appearance
features.case: Switch theme and assert all surfaces repaint from the light/dark tokens.

features.name: New chat
features.case: Start a new chat and assert session.create opens an empty live session.

features.name: Stop turn
features.case: Send a turn, press stop, and assert session.interrupt settles the run.

features.name: Streaming reply
features.case: Send a turn and assert message.start/delta/complete update one assistant row.

features.name: Tool call rows
features.case: Run a tool turn and assert tool.start/tool.complete render one detail row.
